extracted.name: Chicken, Avocado and Mango Salad
extracted.description: This is a colorful and very tasty mix of chicken, mangos, and avocados in a spicy lime dressing.
ingredient_lines: 2 medium mangos - peeled, seeded and diced
instruction_lines: In a saucepan over medium-high heat, stir together the brown sugar and water. Bring to a boil, then pour into a medium bowl. Stir in the garlic chili sauce and lime juice. Set the dressing aside.
In a large bowl, toss together the chicken, mangos and avocados.
Arrange the spring salad mix on serving plates, then top with a few spoonfuls of the chicken mixture. Pour dressing over the top.
